required_concepts: A regular tridecagon has 13 lines of symmetry
A regular tridecagon has rotational symmetry of order 13
acceptable_paraphrases: A regular tridecagon (13-sided polygon) is a shape that has these properties
She is incorrect because a regular tridecagon exists and meets these criteria
There is a 13-sided polygon called a tridecagon with the described symmetry
critical_errors: Mentioning rotational symmetry of order 14 instead of 13
Incorrectly stating that there are no lines or only one line of symmetry for a regular tridecagon
misconceptions: A regular tridecagon cannot have 13 lines of symmetry or rotational symmetry of order 13
Incorrectly stating that there is no such shape as a tridecagon
Confusing the properties of other polygons with those of a tridecagon
grading_notes: Points should be deducted for critical errors and misconceptions. Acceptable paraphrases should not lose points unless they miss key information.
